Interface VirtualViewSocket

All Superinterfaces:
VirtualView
All Known Implementing Classes:
SocketClientHandler
public interface VirtualViewSocket extends VirtualView
Socket-specific marker interface for VirtualView.

Unlike VirtualViewRmi, the Socket transport requires no additional methods or throws refinements: notifications are simply serialised to JSON and written to the socket's output stream. This interface exists purely to mirror the *Rmi / *Socket naming symmetry and to give the Socket implementation (SocketClientHandler) an explicit, transport-specific type.
